Josiah_1: prophesied son of the house of David (1 Kings 13:2), King of Judah and son of Amon (2 Kings 21:24)
Hezekiah_1: King of Judah, son of Ahaz (2 Kings 16:20)
Shaphan_1: scribe of King Josiah (2 Kings 22:3, 2 Chronicles 34:15)
Eliakim_2: King of Judah, son of Josiah (2 Kings 23:34)
Elnathan_1: from Jerusalem, father of Nehushta (2 Kings 24:8), an official (Jeremiah 36:12)
Jeremiah_6: the prophet (2 Chronicles 36:12), son of Hilkiah (Jeremiah 1:1)
Micah_4: of Moresheth (Jeremiah 26:18) authored the book of Micah (Micah 1:1)
Uriah_4: prophesied in the name of the LORD (Jeremiah 26:20)
